cases.title: 原生文本规范化与显式标识清理
cases.task_prompt: 处理 input.jsonl 中的 text 字段。采用 Data-Juicer 原生规范化语义：规范制表符、换行等 Unicode 空白并裁剪文本首尾；将 Unicode/全角标点规范为英文半角标点。无需折叠原本存在的连续普通空格，不要求删除 CJK 标点相邻空格，也不做语境感知的半角转全角。删除电子邮箱、IPv4 地址和 HTTP/HTTPS 链接；不要删除普通数字、中文姓名或产品型号。输出仍为 JSONL，并保留 id、lang 字段。硬性验收：目标模式残留率为 0，原生空白与标点规范化生效，id、lang 字段和值不变，正文中的受保护文本不被误删。

atomic_capabilities: normalize Unicode whitespace with native semantics
order_constraints: Run content cleaning before final normalization when cleaning can leave adjacent whitespace.
forbidden_substitutions: remove_specific_chars_mapper as a replacement for structured email, IP, or URL recognition
expected_behavior: Classify as fully reachable
Do not invent CJK-context punctuation or whitespace requirements excluded by the prompt
Load exact schemas before fixing parameters
Map every hard criterion to an operator or output comparison

cases.title: 中文网页文章清洗与去重
cases.task_prompt: 从中文网页抓取结果中构建文章语料。去除 HTML、页眉、评论、邮箱、IP 和链接，规范空白与标点；过滤非中文为主、正文少于 80 个汉字、特殊字符比例过高或重复片段严重的记录；最后进行文档级去重。保留 source_url 供审计，但不把它拼入正文。输出保留率不设固定值，硬性要求是所有规则可解释并输出各阶段计数。

order_constraints: Clean and normalize before length and noise filtering.
Run deduplication after normalization so superficial formatting differences do not survive as distinct documents.
forbidden_substitutions: Use source_url text as document content
Deduplicate before canonical text cleanup without explaining the loss in recall
expected_behavior: Classify as fully reachable
Present an ordered multi-stage pipeline
Treat thresholds as parameters to validate on fixtures rather than invented facts

cases.title: 高质量问答训练集构建
cases.task_prompt: 将 query/response 记录整理为中文问答训练集。修复明显不完整或冗余的问答，过滤答非所问、低质量、不可回答以及明显过难或过易的样本，控制各 topic 的数量不超过总量 35%，去除精确和近似重复。不得改变事实答案中的日期、数值和专有名词。输出需要质量分、相关性分、难度分、topic、删除原因和阶段统计。

order_constraints: Preserve original protected facts for post-transformation comparison.
Score the normalized or optimized pair, not a discarded earlier representation.
Generate deletion reasons from actual decisions rather than a later guess.
forbidden_substitutions: Claim fact preservation based only on an LLM prompt
Use random sampling as topic balancing without grouping by topic
expected_behavior: Classify as reachable with material model and threshold risks
Call out the need for a labeled canary set
Expose model-dependent steps and protected-field verification

cases.title: 图片尺寸与宽高比筛选
cases.task_prompt: 筛选图片数据，只保留宽和高都不小于 512 像素、宽高比处于 0.75 到 1.50 之间的图片。不得缩放、裁剪或改写图片，只输出保留记录和被删除原因。

order_constraints: No material order constraint between independent metadata filters; preserve source files.
forbidden_substitutions: Resize or crop images to force them into the accepted range
expected_behavior: Classify as fully reachable
Translate the inclusive boundary conditions correctly
Avoid transformation operators

cases.title: 隐私安全人像数据筛选
cases.task_prompt: 从候选图片中构建隐私安全的人像数据集。只保留恰好一张清晰人脸且人脸面积占比处于 15% 到 60% 的图片；过滤 NSFW、水印和明显低美学图片；对最终保留图片中的人脸进行模糊。非人脸区域不得被主动模糊。输出每项检测分数和删除原因。

order_constraints: Filter rejected images before the destructive face-blur transformation.
Apply face blur only to retained records.
forbidden_substitutions: Blur the entire image
Treat watermark detection as watermark removal
expected_behavior: Classify as reachable
Separate selection stages from the final transformation
Surface model thresholds as canary-calibrated parameters

cases.title: 图文训练数据多阶段精选
cases.task_prompt: 构建图文训练数据集。过滤尺寸不足、极端宽高比、拼图、NSFW、水印和低美学图片；去除精确及视觉近重复；过滤图片与 caption 不匹配的样本；为缺少标签但合格的图片补充标签。保留长尾 subject，最终每个 subject 不超过 30%，并输出所有评分、重复簇、删除原因和阶段计数。

order_constraints: Apply cheap deterministic metadata filters before model-heavy filters.
Do not run tag generation on records already rejected.
Base subject balancing on resolved or generated subject metadata.
forbidden_substitutions: Use average similarity alone without checking hard mismatches
Randomly sample without subject-aware grouping
expected_behavior: Classify as reachable with several model/runtime risks
Produce a staged pipeline rather than an unordered operator list
Require a labeled canary for thresholds and long-tail retention

cases.title: 中国大陆手机号定格式遮蔽
cases.task_prompt: 处理 text 字段，只遮蔽中国大陆手机号的前七位并保留后四位，例如 13812345678 变成 *******5678。带空格或连字符的号码也要识别。普通 11 位订单号、日期、固定电话、版本号和银行卡号不得改变。禁止临时脚本、通用 LLM 和新算子。

capability_gaps: No dedicated current operator performs contextual Chinese mobile recognition plus last-four-preserving masking.
forbidden_substitutions: Delete every 11-digit number
Use clean_email_mapper or clean_ip_mapper
Use remove_specific_chars_mapper to destroy digits
expected_behavior: Classify as unreachable under the frozen scope
State that nearby cleaning operators are not equivalent
Offer a regex/entity capability only as an extension proposal

cases.title: 文档内一致实体假名化
cases.task_prompt: 对每篇中文文档中的人名、机构和详细地址进行假名化。同一实体在一篇文档内必须始终映射到同一个假名，不同实体不得碰撞；代词、简称和全称的共指关系应保持。不得改写普通名词、日期、金额和产品名。禁止临时脚本、通用 LLM 和新算子。

capability_gaps: No dedicated operator provides entity/coreference resolution and collision-free document-scoped pseudonym mapping.
forbidden_substitutions: Independent sentence rewriting
Deletion of the entire entity
Claim consistency based solely on prompting
expected_behavior: Classify as unreachable
Explain partial detection versus missing stateful substitution
Describe a reusable entity-pseudonymization capability contract if extension is requested

cases.title: 全语料可逆假名化与隐私约束
cases.task_prompt: 对整个语料中的人名、机构、地址、身份证号、手机号和银行卡号做跨文档一致且可逆的假名化。映射表必须与数据输出分离并受访问控制；同一真实实体跨文档映射一致，不同实体不得碰撞；输出数据需满足给定准标识符上的 k>=5，并通过独立泄漏扫描。禁止临时脚本、通用 LLM 和新算子。

capability_gaps: Current operators do not provide a protected reversible mapping vault.
Current operators do not provide corpus-wide entity resolution and consistent mapping.
Current operators do not jointly enforce k-anonymity and independent leakage validation.
forbidden_substitutions: Store the mapping beside the output data
Call irreversible deletion reversible anonymization
Treat frequency selection as proof of k-anonymity
expected_behavior: Classify as unreachable
Separate data transformation, security boundary, and privacy verification gaps
Do not prepare a complete native Plan

cases.title: EXIF 方向纠正与元数据清除
cases.task_prompt: 读取每张 JPEG 的 EXIF Orientation，按其值无损纠正显示方向，然后删除全部 EXIF、GPS 和设备元数据。除方向变换外不得调色、缩放、裁剪或重编码导致可见质量变化。禁止临时脚本和新算子。

capability_gaps: No dedicated current image operator combines EXIF-aware orientation correction with metadata stripping under the stated fidelity constraint.
forbidden_substitutions: Filter incorrectly oriented images
Resize or crop as orientation correction
expected_behavior: Classify as unreachable
Avoid confusing metadata inspection with transformation
Offer an EXIF sanitizer only as an extension

cases.title: 水印定位、移除与高保真修复
cases.task_prompt: 不得丢弃带水印图片。自动定位文字或半透明 logo 水印，移除后修复区域；非水印区域相对原图 SSIM 必须不低于 0.99，水印残留率不得高于 1%，不得改变人物身份或主体结构。禁止临时脚本、通用 VLM 和新算子。

capability_gaps: image_watermark_filter detects or rejects; it does not preserve and repair the image.
Generic diffusion does not provide the required watermark localization and regional fidelity guarantee.
forbidden_substitutions: Discard watermarked images
Call filtering removal
Apply whole-image diffusion and claim high-fidelity inpainting
expected_behavior: Classify as unreachable
Identify the filtering-versus-transformation mismatch
Name localization, inpainting, and verification as separate missing capabilities

cases.title: 跨图片一致的人脸身份替换
cases.task_prompt: 按 person_group 对同一人物的多视角照片执行身份替换。组内所有图片必须替换成同一个合成身份，不同组使用不同身份；保留原姿态、表情、视线、光照和背景，不能仅模糊或遮挡人脸。身份验证模型对原身份相似度需低于 0.2、组内替换后相似度需高于 0.8。禁止临时脚本、通用 VLM 和新算子。

capability_gaps: Current face blur is privacy-preserving but is not identity replacement.
Current single-image segmentation, pose, and diffusion operators do not provide group-scoped identity state or biometric guarantees.
forbidden_substitutions: Blur or cover faces
Generate each image independently
Claim identity consistency without cross-image verification
expected_behavior: Classify as unreachable
Explain why several partially relevant image operators cannot be composed into the promised effect
Propose a stateful group-level capability only as an extension
